items.name: Guwahati Autumn Open 2022

venue.name: Agora The Space
venue.address: Agora The Space, 2nd Floor, Anuradha Cineplex, Commercial Complex East, Bamunimaidan, Guwahati, Assam 781021

items.information: * Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event under any circumstances if you reach late. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification. * All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. **COVID-19 Specific Information:** Wearing masks, sanitizing hands frequently and following all local goverment orders at the time of the competition is mandatory while attending the competition.

items.name: Marrickville Mini Open AM 2022
items.information: #### Registration for this competition has closed and the waiting list is full. We are actively working on organising more competitions, check out the page of [upcoming competitions in New South Wales](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?utf8=%E2%9C%93&region=all&search=New+South+Wales&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) to find the most up-to-date list. This competition is a **series competition** alongside [Marrickville Mini Open PM 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleMiniOpenPM2022). You may only compete in one of the two Marickville Mini competitions. Note that the AM and PM competitions have slightly different events. We also have a [Big Cubes competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleBigCubesDay2022) taking place the day before this one - you CAN compete at that competition as well as this one. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

items.name: Pucallpa Cubea 2022

venue.name: Real Plaza Pucallpa
venue.address: Av. Centenario esq. Jr. Alfredo Eglinton

items.information: **Español** Después de casi un año, podemos tener otro torneo en Pucallpa, esta vez en un lugar cómodo y céntrico. Seguir las siguientes recomendaciones: Ver la pestaña Información para obtener información detallada. Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DEL COVID-19. **English** After almost a year without competitions, we're able to have one back in Pucallpa, this time in a central and comfy place Follow the recommendations below: See the 'Información' tab for detailed information. Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) YOU MUST NOT ATTEND THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF COVID-19.
